echo.map: <Corin> That map you took. Half the outposts on it are ash now.
echo.spared: <Corin> The captain you spared rode north last night. He'll remember you.

codex.me: The Gazebound keep an outpost on the road ahead.
codex.pip: Kai always said the Gazebound kept an outpost on this road. I walk to it alone now.

steps.journal: A Gazebound outpost, somewhere ahead. Find it.

steps.failed: I fell, and the guards still stand.
steps.journal: Its guards stand between me and the captain.
The captain kneels in the mud.
steps.prompt: <Captain> Spare me, and you'll have my map.
